description.value: Koon Bo Seafood Restaurant is a long-established Cantonese eatery tucked into a strip mall near Fraser and 41st Avenue in Vancouver, serving traditional Guangdong-style cuisine since 1998. Known locally as a quiet 'hidden gem,' it draws a loyal following with standout dishes like house special shredded chicken, roast squab, Peking duck (advance order required), and a broad dim sum selection. Online ordering is available directly through the restaurant's site as well as through Uber Eats and DoorDash.

Takeout is clearly evidenced by the 'Online Order', Uber Eats, and DoorDash links on the homepage. No website or OSM content addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities, so all required criteria and most optional amenities must remain null.
